a trim figure: After a year of swimming and eating healthy meals, my aunt has kept a trim figure that everyone admires.
經過一年的游泳和健康飲食，我阿姨保持著人人羨慕的修長結實的身材。
in trim: The coach wants every player to stay in trim during the summer break, so they must exercise daily.
教練希望每位球員在暑假期間保持身材健美，所以他們必須每天運動。
trim the budget: Because ticket sales were low this year, the school had to trim the budget for the music festival.
由於今年門票銷售不佳，學校不得不削減音樂節的預算。
keep oneself trim: My grandfather keeps himself trim by walking five kilometers every morning and avoiding sweet drinks.
我祖父每天早上走五公里並避免含糖飲料來保持身材。
triple the price: During the typhoon, some shops sold vegetables at triple the price, three times what they normally cost.
颱風期間，有些商店以平常價格的三倍販售蔬菜。
a triple jump: In the triple jump, athletes hop, step, and then jump into the sand pit in one smooth movement.
在三級跳遠中，選手以一個流暢的動作單足跳、跨步，然後跳進沙坑。
triple digits: Temperatures in the desert can reach triple digits, so visitors must carry plenty of water.
沙漠中的氣溫可能達到三位數，所以遊客必須攜帶大量的水。
a trivial matter: Please don't call the manager about such a trivial matter; it is too small to worry about.
請不要為了這種瑣碎的小事打電話給經理；它小到不值得擔心。
trivial details: Her report was full of trivial details, so the main point was hard to find among the unimportant facts.
她的報告充滿無關緊要的細節，所以很難在不重要的事實中找到重點。
a trivial mistake: Don't feel bad about such a trivial mistake; one wrong comma will not affect your final grade.
別為這樣一個微不足道的錯誤難過；一個用錯的逗號不會影響你的總成績。
far from trivial: Losing your passport abroad is far from trivial; it can ruin your whole trip and cost a lot.
在國外遺失護照絕非小事；它可能毀了你整趟旅程並花費大量金錢。
trivial pursuits: He wasted the whole weekend on trivial pursuits like scrolling through videos instead of studying for the exam.
他把整個週末浪費在像滑影片這種無聊的消遣上，而不是準備考試。
a tropical climate: Southern Taiwan has a tropical climate, with hot, wet summers and warm winters almost all year round.
台灣南部屬於熱帶氣候，幾乎全年夏季炎熱潮濕、冬季溫暖。
tropical fruit: Mangoes, papayas, and pineapples are popular tropical fruit that grow well in hot, sunny places.
芒果、木瓜和鳳梨是在炎熱、陽光充足的地方生長良好的受歡迎熱帶水果。
a tropical storm: A tropical storm formed over the warm ocean and brought heavy rain and strong winds to the island.
一個熱帶風暴在溫暖的海洋上形成，為該島帶來豪雨和強風。
the tropical rainforest: The tropical rainforest near the equator is home to millions of plants and animals found nowhere else.
赤道附近的熱帶雨林是數百萬種其他地方找不到的動植物的家園。
a troublesome child: The teacher had to deal with a troublesome child who refused to sit down and kept shouting in class.
老師必須應付一個拒絕坐下、在課堂上不停大叫的難管教的孩子。
a troublesome issue: Parking near the night market has become a troublesome issue that the city still cannot solve.
夜市附近停車已成為市政府仍無法解決的麻煩的問題。
a troublesome cough: I have had a troublesome cough for three weeks, and it keeps me awake every night.
我已經有難纏的咳嗽三週了，它讓我每晚都睡不著。
a truthful answer: When the police asked where he had been, the boy gave a truthful answer instead of making up a story.
當警察問他去了哪裡時，男孩給了誠實的回答，而沒有編造故事。
be truthful with someone: If you want your parents to trust you, you should be truthful with them about your grades.
如果你希望父母信任你，你應該對他們說實話，坦白你的成績。
a truthful account: The witness gave a truthful account of the accident, describing exactly what she had seen that night.
目擊者對事故做出了真實的敘述，精確描述她那晚所看到的情況。
the ultimate goal: Passing the exam is important, but the ultimate goal of learning English is to communicate with people worldwide.
通過考試很重要，但學英文的終極目標是與全世界的人溝通。
the ultimate test: Climbing the highest mountain in Asia was the ultimate test of his strength and courage.
攀登亞洲最高的山是對他體力和勇氣的最終的考驗。
the ultimate sacrifice: Many soldiers made the ultimate sacrifice, giving their lives to protect their country and families.
許多士兵犧牲生命，奉獻出他們的性命來保護國家和家人。
the ultimate in luxury: With a private pool and a personal chef, the hotel suite offers the ultimate in luxury.
擁有私人泳池和專屬廚師，這間飯店套房提供了奢華的極致。
ultimate responsibility: Although many workers made mistakes, the company president has ultimate responsibility for the safety of every product.
雖然許多員工犯了錯，公司總裁對每項產品的安全負有最終責任。
the ultimate weapon: In the movie, the scientists build the ultimate weapon, a machine powerful enough to destroy any enemy.
在電影中，科學家們打造出終極武器，一台強大到足以摧毀任何敵人的機器。
